Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the Planner's analysis after the second WebSurfer search), the Planner hallucinated the release date for "The Beginning or the End". The WebSurfer had correctly identified the film as a 1947 release (specifically February 19, 1947) in the first turn. However, in this step, the Planner incorrectly claimed the date was "June 28, 1957". This fabrication of data led to the incorrect conclusion that "Hold Back the Night" (1956) was released first, when in reality "The Beginning or the End" (1947) was released first.
